frozen_at: 2026-10-10, before any formal run (only 1-epoch smoke tests executed, results discarded from analysis)
question: Under QDF's released ETTh1/ETTh2 TQNet configuration, how much of QDF's reported MSE reduction over the TQNet baseline is due to the learned horizon matrix Sigma, versus training configuration differences?

QDF.note: latest public commit; predates the ICLR 2026 camera-ready, so equivalence to the paper's code is not established

code.launcher: cpu_launch.py (stubs missing optional packages; counts runtime stub use; numpy Inf/NaN aliases; torch.load weights_only=False for self-written checkpoints). Upstream source files unmodified.
code.data: ETTh1.csv / ETTh2.csv shipped in the QDF repo, copied into TQNet/dataset (sha256 prefixes AAF53BECAD03AD8A / AE5C99B925FB8B4E)

environment: Windows, CPU only, torch 2.13.0+cpu, Python 3.12; OMP/MKL threads = 1 per run; num_workers = 0

arms.QDF: QDF scripts/ETTh{1,2}.sh settings for the given pred_len, task long_term_forecast_meta_ml3, fix_seed=seed
arms.SIGMA_I: identical to QDF except --meta_lr 0; meta phase still runs, so model init and batch order are identical; Sigma stays (I+1e-6)^2
arms.TQNET_OFFICIAL: official TQNet run.py with scripts/TQNet/etth{1,2}.sh settings (lr 0.001, batch 256, lradj type3, dropout 0.5, 30 epochs, patience 5), random_seed=seed

metrics: test MSE and MAE on normalized scale over the full test set, as printed by each codebase; test window counts must match across codebases

reported_reference.source: QDF paper (ICLR 2026) Appendix Table 7, TQNet rows; official TQNet result.txt (seed 2024)

quantities.sigma_stats: from saved A.pth: ||Sigma - I||_F / sqrt(T), eigenvalue min/max, mean off-diagonal correlation

decision_rules_per_cell.SIGMA_EFFECT: mean g_sigma >= 0.5 * g_rep and g_sigma > 0 for at least 4 of 5 seeds
decision_rules_per_cell.NO_SIGMA_EFFECT: |mean g_sigma| < 0.25 * g_rep, or fewer than 4 of 5 seeds positive while mean g_sigma < 0.5 * g_rep

decision_rules_overall.CONTINUE_Q1_DIAGNOSTIC: NO_SIGMA_EFFECT in >= 3 of 4 cells, including ETTh1-720
decision_rules_overall.STOP_Q1_DIAGNOSTIC: SIGMA_EFFECT in >= 2 cells including ETTh1-720; the learned Sigma then matters and Q1's premise fails
decision_rules_overall.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise; report as is, no threshold changes

reproduction_check: QDF arm mean within 3% of QDF_reported per cell; if not, flag REPRODUCTION_GAP and interpret g_sigma only as a statement about the released code
integrity: all runs (including failures) appended to results/runs.jsonl; summary generated only by summarize.py; any later analysis is a new protocol version labelled post hoc
